claims: The Artemis II mission does not use a SpaceX rocket.
The Artemis II mission uses NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The SLS rocket is built by Boeing and Northrop Grumman.
The Orion spacecraft is built by Lockheed Martin.
The SLS is a government-developed, expendable super heavy-lift launch vehicle.
Artemis II will carry four astronauts around the Moon and back.
Artemis II serves as a test flight for the Artemis program.
SpaceX is not involved in launching the Artemis II crew.
NASA contracted SpaceX to provide a human landing system for future lunar surface missions (Artemis III and beyond).
